questions.stem: A 28-year-old woman presents with joint stiffness, fatigue, low-grade fever, and a photosensitive facial rash. She reports generalized body aches and difficulty performing daily tasks due to pain and stiffness in her hands and knees. Routine blood work reveals mild anemia. Urinalysis is unremarkable. A provisional diagnosis of SLE was made. Based on prevalence rates of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) manifestations during the disease course, which of the following is the most likely presenting cutaneous feature in this patient?
